title: Group quarters population by major group quarters type

tag: by row: P5 and P28 SOURCED, blocks ESTIMATED (see tables)
limits: A count on Census Day, April 1, 2020, during the pandemic: college students were counted at their campus housing under the residence rule even where they had gone home, so college counts reflect campus housing, not who was physically there. The redistricting tables carry the 2020 disclosure-avoidance noise below the state level (group-quarters counts by type are not held invariant), so a small place can show a few residents in a type it has no facility of. Island-area counts are P28, whose group-quarters values the Census Bureau partially synthesized for disclosure avoidance. A row whose table is blocks is ESTIMATED: a place drawn or redrawn since 2020, counted from the 2020 blocks inside its 2025 boundary, and listed under estimated with its spread. A block counts as inside when its internal point is, so a facility on a block the boundary splits is counted all inside or all outside; where the ACS on the same land shows that sum wrong, the row is the 2020 row plus only the boundary-crossing blocks that bring it toward the ACS, and a block such a row keeps is taken out of the place its internal point now lies in, so none is counted twice; a split block on a place whose boundary moved since 2024 has no such check. A row listed under renamed is the 2020 row of the same place under its older code.
